title: Books & Co.

description.main: A sixteen-page checklist of Eric Doeringer's Copycat Publications artist books, published in an edition of 100 for his April 2026 exhibition of twenty-six of those books at Arcana: Books on the Arts in Culver City.
description.extended:
A sixteen-page checklist of Eric Doeringer's artist books, made as a zine for his April 2026 exhibition at Arcana: Books on the Arts in Culver City.

The show put twenty-six of the books Doeringer has issued under his Copycat Publications imprint on view, and this booklet lists them with twenty-six black-and-white illustrations. The artists whose books he has remade include Ed Ruscha, Richard Prince, Sol LeWitt, Dieter Roth, On Kawara and John Baldessari. The cover shows Doeringer lying on a satin sheet among copies of his books, printed in green. The title borrows from Ed Ruscha: Books & Co., Bob Monk's 2013 Gagosian exhibition of Ruscha's books and work by artists who answered them. Doeringer was in that show, which travelled to Munich, Paris and Beverly Hills. The booklet is stapled, in pictorial wrappers, published in Los Angeles in a first edition of 100 copies.

Doeringer (b. 1974) sells "bootleg" copies of other artists' work and reissues artists' books under Copycat Publications. The library also holds three of his books. Records (2011) remakes Ruscha's 1971 book. 121 Nurses (2023) is built from the paperbacks behind Prince's Nurse Paintings, and Cliff's Notes for Catcher in the Rye by Richard Prince (2018) is a study guide to Prince's Salinger facsimile.

notes: Exhibition checklist and zine for Eric Doeringer's show of twenty-six Copycat Publications artist books at Arcana: Books on the Arts, 8675 Washington Blvd., Culver City; opening Saturday 11 April 2026, on view through 8 May 2026. Details per Arcana (inventory E00260411): Los Angeles, CA: Copycat Publications, 2026, first edition of 100 copies, 8 1/2 x 5 1/2 in, stapled pictorial wrappers, np (16 pp), 26 b&w illustrations. No ISBN. Also stocked by Printed Matter (catalog page not located). Title echoes Ed Ruscha: Books & Co. (Gagosian New York 2013, curated by Bob Monk; Museum Brandhorst 2013, Gagosian Paris 2015, Gagosian Beverly Hills 2016), listed on Doeringer's CV. Cover is Arcana's 310x471 image, the largest offered. Etsy listing 4538484228 (eric-doeringer-books-co-artist-book), supplied by the owner, returned 403 and could not be read.
